module.purpose: Provides the application layout wrapper for booking-page routes, supplying request-specific security metadata and booking-specific configuration to the shared page wrapper.
module.summary: This asynchronous route layout reads the incoming request's nonce header, converts a missing value to undefined, and renders the shared application page wrapper around child route content. It marks the route as a booking page, disables license requirements, and preserves the request nonce for downstream rendering.
module.businessContext: Supports booking workflows by applying consistent page-level behavior and security metadata. Failure can break booking-page rendering or prevent nonce-dependent security policies from being applied.
functions: BookingPageWrapperLayout (~L5-16): Reads the request nonce and wraps booking route content.

io: Reads the incoming request headers through Next.js headers().

preconditions: The children argument contains a React.ReactNode.

Passes isBookingPage=true and requiresLicense=false to PageWrapper.

invariants: The children value is forwarded without transformation.
The wrapper configuration always uses isBookingPage=true and requiresLicense=false.
edgeCases: When x-nonce is absent, nonce is passed to PageWrapper as undefined.
When x-nonce is present, its header value is passed unchanged as nonce.
Any error raised while reading headers or constructing the wrapped element propagates to the caller.
